# GitHub Repository Topics

Apply these topics via GitHub web UI (Settings → Topics) or `gh repo edit`:

```
zerodha kite portfolio-analysis stock-analysis claude-code mcp india-stocks nse bse
fundamental-analysis technical-analysis weinstein concall-analysis ai-finance
financial-analysis algorithmic-trading dark-mode dashboard
```

## gh CLI command (run from your local machine with network access):

```bash
gh repo edit iamurali/kite-portfolio-ai \
  --add-topic zerodha \
  --add-topic kite \
  --add-topic portfolio-analysis \
  --add-topic stock-analysis \
  --add-topic claude-code \
  --add-topic mcp \
  --add-topic india-stocks \
  --add-topic nse \
  --add-topic bse \
  --add-topic fundamental-analysis \
  --add-topic technical-analysis \
  --add-topic weinstein \
  --add-topic concall-analysis \
  --add-topic ai-finance \
  --add-topic financial-analysis \
  --add-topic algorithmic-trading \
  --add-topic dashboard
```
